preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the first part of the graph is between 1 and 2000, inclusive.
The number of vertices in the second part of the graph is between 1 and 2000, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 2000, inclusive.
Each vertex index in the first part is between 1 and n1, inclusive.
Each vertex index in the second part is between 1 and n2, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each edge is represented by a unique pair of vertex indices (ui, vi)
preconditions.description: Each edge is represented by a unique pair of vertex indices (ui, vi) where ui is the index of a vertex in the first part and vi is the index of a vertex in the second part.

postconditions.expression: The output contains one line for each value of k from 0 to minDegree, inclusive.
postconditions.description: The output contains one line for each value of k from 0 to minDegree, inclusive, where minDegree is the minimal degree of any vertex in the graph.

postconditions.expression: The first integer on the k-th line is the number of edges in the minimal k-covering.
postconditions.description: The first integer on the k-th line is the number of edges in the minimal k-covering.

postconditions.expression: The subsequent integers on the k-th line are the original indices of the edges which belong to the minimal k-covering.
postconditions.description: The subsequent integers on the k-th line are the original indices of the edges which belong to the minimal k-covering, these indices should be pairwise distinct.

postconditions.expression: The output is the minimal k-covering for each value of k from 0 to minDegree, inclusive.
postconditions.description: The output is the minimal k-covering for each value of k from 0 to minDegree, inclusive.
